## Time Complexity - O(n)O(\sqrt{n})O(n​)

Let's calculate the time complexity for the following code:

```python
1def print_numbers(n):
2    i = 1
3    k = 1
4    
5    while k < n:
6        print(k)
7 
8        # add i to the value of k 
9        k = k + i
10
11        i = i + 1
12
13n = 10
14print_numbers(n)
```

Output

```text
1
2
4
7
```

The time complexity of the above program will be around O(n)O(\sqrt{n})O(n​) and not exactly O(n)O(\sqrt{n})O(n​). We elaborate on this distinction later on in this course..

For the moment, just keep in mind that algorithms may have time complexities other than O(n), O(n2)O(n^2)O(n2), O(logn), and O(1) too.
